title: NEBNext Ultra II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina Part 4: Second cDNA Strand Synthesis
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Set temperature module to 4 °C
steps.instruction: Cool the temperature module down to 4 °C (this can be done manually before starting the protocol).

steps.title: Add reaction buffer
steps.instruction: Dispense 8 µL of reaction buffer from the temperature module (slot 3, column 1) into each sample.

steps.title: Add enzyme mix and mix
steps.instruction: Add 4 µL of enzyme mix from the temperature module (slot 3, column 3) to each sample, then mix to combine.

steps.title: Add water and mix
steps.instruction: Add 48 µL of nuclease‑free water from slot 4, column 12 to each sample, then mix.

steps.title: Finalize protocol
steps.instruction: Protocol is complete; the OT‑2 will flash to alert the user.
